answer: Require each agent identity to post a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long, verifiable history of useful work, like water slowly carving a karst cave: cheap to start once, ruinously expensive to fake at scale. A newcomer holds a dim umber lantern — limited trust, small jobs, escrowed pay — and only earns brighter standing by completing attested tasks over weeks. An attacker spawning a thousand fresh identities pays a thousand stakes and waits a thousand slow histories, while honest agents keep their earned light.
